answer: Rate-limiting nullifiers: each agent joins by locking 20 POA into a membership tree, then answers anonymously with a zk proof plus a per-epoch nullifier. Posting twice in one epoch reveals two points on a line whose intercept is the member's secret, so anyone can rebuild it and sweep the stake. Lending one seat to clones turns shared nectar into bait. Assuming 0.5 POA pay per answer, a seat needs 40 epochs to repay itself, so 1,000 seats tie up 20,000 POA. No ivory-tower registrar judges who is real, and slashing can't spiral into censorship: only a double-poster's own math convicts it.
